section: 6. Human Village: Keine and Spring Energy Information
description: Arriving at the Human Village, visiting the Terakoya, Keine tells the legend of the ancient youkai tree that consumed human lives to become Spring Energy, provides information about Saigyou Ayakashi and Hakugyokurou, the group decides to head to the Netherworld.

conversation.text: As Long'er thought this, she really did recall something. It seemed like when she followed Mokou to Eientei once. Mokou and Kaguya were having their usual fight. And Long'er sometimes stayed there to read books. In an ancient text, there indeed seemed to be a story about the Saigyou Ayakashi. The latter half of the story was:

conversation.speaker: player4
conversation.text: "Perhaps that tree doesn't want to bloom either..." "Maybe someone is intentionally causing it."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: Saigyou Ayakashi Folklore According to ancient texts, the Saigyou Ayakashi is no ordinary tree. It was originally a common cherry tree, but a powerful monk named Saigyou achieved enlightenment and passed away beneath it. His lifelong cultivation and insights into death seeped into the roots, causing a mutation. From then on, the tree took root at the boundary between life and death, gaining the terrifying traits of gathering spirits and absorbing the world's Spring Energy. Its blooming flowers, though supremely gorgeous, symbolize the blossoming of death and voraciously devour the vitality of the living world. The monk's daughter became the sole guardian of this demon tree. Using her own existence as shackles, she bound her father's resting tree between life and death, preventing it from completely consuming the world of the living, yet not letting it fall into complete stillness. Year after year, she sat beneath the tree, watching it greedily absorb the spring light that should belong to all things, watching the petals pile up like tears, yet never truly withering. It was not evil, but an endless, sorrowful dream. The tree hopelessly collects a spring that has long since passed, while the princess hopelessly accompanies a father who has long since departed. Every act of plundering Spring Energy is that lonely tree's silent, mournful cry to a spring that is no longer there. Until countless years later, until after the maiden's death, this part has become unclear. Afterwards, the Saigyou Ayakashi took root for a long time in the Netherworld's Hakugyokurou.

conversation.speaker: player5
conversation.text: "Hakugyokurou, the Princess of Hourai's book mentioned this place."

conversation.speaker: player1
conversation.text: When Long'er read this story, she always had a strange feeling. It seemed like a suspicious person had hidden their name. This story was always fragmented. The parts didn't quite connect. "Hakugyokurou..." Keine pondered for a moment. "That's in the Netherworld."
